en.answer: In that case, since that Pendulum monster is treated as a Spell Card, it is not banished by the effect of <<9154>> and is added to the Extra Deck normally.
en.question: While the effect of <<9154>> is applying, if a Pendulum monster in a Pendulum Zone is destroyed, is it added to the Extra Deck?
